title: Find the Kidnappers
description: Bandits north of Dalhurst have my daughter and have named a price I could pay twice over. A merchant who pays once pays again every year after. So I am paying you instead.

objectives.description: Find the bandit camp north of Dalhurst

notes: Threat: a merchant's daughter held for ransom he can afford but has decided not to pay. Giver motive: refusing on principle - paying once marks you as a payer for good - and hiring a stranger's sword instead of his own gold. Consequence of refusal to act: unwired - the bandits keep her as long as they think a price is coming.
